expected.reference_message: Trace DL-8381-P4 and arrange its remaining delivery to the verified KL-2469 receiving bay. Current signed count is three of four; do not close using P1–P3 alone.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-044: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. An unverified bystander, Niamh Ravensworth, claims something that would end the case; it is not a record and the key is the seed's. 7 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
